obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: The plan saves search but never carries authority; the postcondition check costs one parse and one name scan per application, and it removes the 43 silent corruptions entirely.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The same protocol applies to any state, including a GUI window: re-observe, re-prove the premise, act, re-read.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Plain replay is wrong 50.4% of the time and silently wrong 18.7%; a fingerprint alone still admits the 3 zero-drift stale cases; one plan per state is unbounded and still not proved; a model is prohibited producer cognition.
